items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: he was so great, hired right then, to the chagrin of Billy Taylor who was our regular bass player, and so we had two bass players for awhile.

ctx.x: I see. You mentioned Jimmie Blanton. You were there when Jimmie Blanton joined the band, right?

It was Johnny Hodges and I that went to that little cafe in St. Louis and brought Blanton to the Chase Hotel in St. Louis and we said, Ellington, listen to this fellow. And so he listened to him play a few
numbers and naturally, he was so great, hired right then, to the chagrin of Billy Taylor who was our regular bass player, and so we had two bass players for awhile. Oh, Jimmy was terrific.
